title: Zyxel security advisory (AV26-1167)
description: As of November 17, 2026, Zyxel is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
DX3300-T0 firmware
	Prior to or equal to 5.50(ABVY.8.3)C0

DX3301-T0 firmware
	Prior to or equal to 5.50(ABVY.8.3)C0

EX3301-T0 firmware
	Prior to or equal to 5.50(ABVY.8.3)C0
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
